description: Real age v1 X25519 sealed-note vectors for sentilab-open-sealed/1 (DESIGN.md section 3.7; test plan T15), sealed by the implementation named under generator. manifest_id is a placeholder: re-seal per manifest with make_age_vectors.seal_cases(manifest_id). Open a note with age_tools.parse_note, then age_tools.reference_decrypt with the key version its first line names.

format.key_version: a positive integer without leading zeros
format.armour: after the first line's LF: -----BEGIN AGE ENCRYPTED FILE-----, canonical padded standard base64 in 64-column lines (the last 4 to 64 columns), then -----END AGE ENCRYPTED FILE-----; LF line endings; the final LF is optional
format.age: age-encryption.org/v1 to one X25519 recipient; openers ignore unrecognised stanzas

identity_rule: Test identities only: the X25519 scalar is sha256 of the UTF-8 phrase, and the recipient is Bech32 (human-readable part age) of X25519(scalar, basepoint). Derive the scalar at run time; no key is stored here.

keys.phrase: sentilab-open-proposal-v1 test age key 1, not a secret
sentilab-open-proposal-v1 test age key 2, not a secret
